senses.gloss:
fn. (-डुः-डु)
A lunar mansion or constellation in the moon's path.
n. (-डु)
Water.
E.
उत् above, डीङ् to go or fly, डु aff.

mn. (-पः-पं)
A raft or float.
m. (-पः)
The moon.
E.
उडु as above, and प from पा to preserve, affix ड.

mn. (-पः-पं)
A raft, a float.
m. (-पः)
The moon: see उडुप.

m. (-तिः)
The moon.
E.
उडु and पति lord.

m. (-थः)
The firmament.
E.
उडु a constellation, and पथ a path.

m. (-रः)
1 Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.)
2 The threshold of a house.
3 A eunuch.
4 A species of leprosy with coppery spots.
5 A kind of worm, supposed to be generated in the blood, and to produce leprosy.
n. (-रं)
1 Copper.
2 A Karṣa, a measure of two Tolas.
E.
उडु a constellation in the second case, वृ to screen, and अप् affix; it is also written उडुम्बर and उटुम्बर.

f. (-र्णी)
The name of a plant: see दन्ती.
E.
उडुम्बर and पर्ण a leaf: whose leaves are of the color of copper.
